description: Placed blocks of the mod. Each carries its real-world basis and lore role.

description.en: Surface ore block of bauxite; mined with any pickaxe. The crusher reduces it to crushed bauxite.
description.ru: Поверхностный рудный блок боксита; добывается любой киркой. Дробилка превращает его в дроблёный боксит.

realWorld.basis: Bauxite is a surficial laterite formed by tropical weathering — hence near-surface generation in the mod.
